headline: Why do I keep getting blocked before my soulmate arrives?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x keyword. NO PARTICULAR MAN EXISTS — the read must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴 The ad already tells her she is the problem, which is the best fit on the funnel for this method: the card acquits her, and the block is what is left.

⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6. The return-mhf figures are all male, so he is DESCRIBED in beats 1-2 and retired there — never given intent or motion toward her, or a soulmate lander turns into reunion copy.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

⚠ 'KEEP getting blocked' is the ad's own repetition, so beat 4 may say it has gone this way before. It may NOT say how many times — a count is the exact fault that retired the cold read.

a: You turned the Magician. You had nothing to go on, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. Four things laid out, and every one within reach.
You asked why you keep getting blocked before your soulmate arrives. What catches me is that nothing on that table is held back.
And yet nobody has come. And it has gone this way before.
Something is sitting in the gap itself. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing marked them apart, and you took the one held by a single thing.
Look at the rope. One ankle, and the rest of him hangs free.
You asked why you keep getting blocked before your soulmate arrives. This card shows how little it takes to hold all of it.
Still, nobody has come. And it stops just before the part you're waiting for.
The hold is even — it never tightens and it never slackens. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you chose the one already stepping.
Look at his feet. One has left the ground, and the other is following.
You asked why you keep getting blocked before your soulmate arrives. This card brings me to a step in the middle of being taken.
But nobody has come. And the stop comes early, before it gets going.
Something turns up just before that would happen. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
